_meta.note: Supplier registry — the vetted sourcing layer for the orchestrator. Channel legend matches catalogue.json: sa_trade = duty embedded, import = SACU MFN duty applies, local = Botswana manufacture. Costs are landed-cost anchors — replace with live price-list date.
_meta.disclaimer: All data sourced from public sites pre-29 Oct 2026. Verify trade terms, MOQ and HS codes with a live price list before quoting.

suppliers.name: Amrod Botswana (Amrod)
suppliers.hq: Gaborone (Broadhurst) + Johannesburg + Cape Town + 14 African markets
suppliers.moq_note: No MOQ on stock; branding MOQ per method
suppliers.pricing: Tier pricing by distributor volume; margin benchmark 31.6% SA avg [S2]
suppliers.strength: Breadth, price, in-house branding, distributor tools, credit terms
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Trade-only (will not sell direct to corporates); Gaborone is sales/warehouse not service network; no tender pack; no local fitting/store
suppliers.contact_hint: Amrod Gaborone — Broadhurst; request distributor trade form + tier list
suppliers.compliance: Certificates on file per SKU; BOBS CoC handled at source for SA stock

suppliers.name: Barron (Barron Clothing / ProBrand Group)
suppliers.scale: Flagship SA corporate clothing brand — banks, mines, retail use Barron sizing as standard
suppliers.pricing: Brand premium 8–15% above generic; consistency outweighs price for programme buyers
suppliers.strength: Brand pull, size consistency, mining/public-sector spec compliance
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Cross-border 5–10 days, Pula/ZAR friction, no local decoration, no store, no tender localisation
suppliers.contact_hint: Barron SA distributor portal; also via ProBrand reseller layer

suppliers.name: Jonsson Workwear
suppliers.hq: Johannesburg + 30+ stores SA, export to SADC
suppliers.moq_note: Retail/wholesale — no MOQ on stocked lines; bulk pricing 50+
suppliers.scale: Largest SA workwear brand — mining, construction, industrial core
suppliers.pricing: Mid-premium; EN ISO 20471/11612 certified ranges; lifespan vs price is pitch
suppliers.trade_account: Trade/wholesale enquiry — backup for conti, D59, hi-vis
suppliers.strength: Durability, certified PPE, consistent sizing, large stock depth
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Retail footprint not a B2B programme; no Botswana decoration/kitting/store; cross-border delays
suppliers.contact_hint: jonsson.co.za trade enquiries; also via industrial stockists

suppliers.name: Industrial Clothing (Viking / Industrial & Safety)
suppliers.scale: Broad safety catalogue — boots, gumboots, gloves, masks, aprons
suppliers.pricing: Competitive on commodity PPE — use for price benchmarking
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Commodity-only; no decoration, no programme, no certificate pack service
suppliers.status: Benchmark — collect price list for PPE
suppliers.contact_hint: industrialclothing.co.za — request wholesale list + lead time to Gabs

suppliers.name: TwentyFour (24.store)
suppliers.type: SA promo distributor (online catalogue, visible pricing)
suppliers.moq_note: Visible MOQ per SKU on site; bulk tiers 50/100/500
suppliers.scale: Growing SA online promo platform — known for transparent pricing
suppliers.pricing: Visible retail/wholesale — useful live benchmark for SA trade price
suppliers.trade_account: Benchmark + overflow — scrape visible price as SA street price
suppliers.strength: E-commerce pricing transparency — sets buyer expectation
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: No Botswana presence, no decoration bundle, no local content credit
suppliers.status: Benchmark — use visible prices to validate tier margins
suppliers.contact_hint: twentyfour.store — cross-check golf shirts, caps, T-shirts vs Amrod tier

suppliers.name: Jasani Trading (Jasani.ae)
suppliers.hq: Dubai, UAE — corporate gifts & premiums, ships globally
suppliers.moq_note: MOQ 50–100; FOB Dubai + freight + SACU duty 0–15% (gifts lower than clothing 40–45%)
suppliers.scale: Mid-East gifting consolidator — power banks, bottles, notebooks, backpacks
suppliers.pricing: Low FOB on tech/gifts; watch freight & import timing (6–8 weeks landed Gabs)
suppliers.trade_account: China/UAE import alternative (BDB-003) — quote 3 lines at 500+
suppliers.strength: Gift/tech pricing, bundling, branding options ex-factory
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Long lead, MOQ, no local compliance pack, no Botswana after-sales
suppliers.contact_hint: jasani.ae — request FOB + HS code + carton specs for 3 SKUs
suppliers.hs_note: Gifts: HS 8471/8517 tech, 3926/4202 bags — verify each line

suppliers.name: Direct China Agent (Shenzhen/Yiwu lane)
suppliers.moq_note: MOQ 500–1000; sampling 7–14 days; FOB + sea/air freight + clearing + duty
suppliers.scale: Factory cost — cheapest unit for high-run commodity
suppliers.pricing: FOB 40–60% below SA trade on high run, but add 40–45% clothing duty + VAT + freight
suppliers.trade_account: BDB-003 — cost 3 SKUs landed (FOB→Gabs) to validate margin
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Longest lead, MOQ risk, BOBS CoC before arrival (Apr 2024 regs), quality variance — requires sample + audit
suppliers.status: BDB-003 — HS classify + landed calc before any volume
suppliers.contact_hint: Via clearing agent — get HS, duty, freight per CBM for one 20ft equivalent

suppliers.name: Botswana Cut-Make-Trim (Local manufacture)
suppliers.type: Local CMT — local content value addition
suppliers.moq_note: MOQ 100–300 per style/colour; 10–14 days after fabric arrival
suppliers.scale: Small-batch local — tender advantage (10–15% preference margin incl. textiles [S22])
suppliers.pricing: Higher unit than import, but tender pricing power via local-content statement qualifies for preference
suppliers.strength: Local-content credit in PPRA tenders + mining 10% locally-produced preference; short chain
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Capacity constrained, fabric still imported, QC varies — requires audit + trial
suppliers.contact_hint: LEA/CEDA factory list + referral; request capacity, MOQ, unit cost, audit evidence

suppliers.name: ProBrand / Brandability / PromoAlliance (SA distributor pool)
suppliers.scale: 300+ reseller buying group — price leverage, catalog depth
suppliers.pricing: Discounted SA trade — benchmark for tier-2 product
suppliers.trade_account: Overflow — if Amrod/Barron short on colour/size
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Not a source of margin — distributor margin layer you bypass as orchestrator

suppliers.name: Hadida / Sondor (SA bag & headwear specialists)
suppliers.scale: Strong in backpacks, totes, beanies, caps — alternatives to Amrod range
suppliers.pricing: Mid-range; strong when Amrod colour/size gaps appear
suppliers.strength: Depth in bags/headwear where Amrod range is thin
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Narrow vertical — not a full-range competitor

suppliers.name: Gaborone Buffer Stock (Owned)
category: Fast movers — tee, vest, cap, bottle
suppliers.moq_note: No MOQ — immediate issue; replenish at 35-day cover
suppliers.scale: Cap ≤35 inventory days; ≤50 SKUs — asset-light rule [docs/03]
suppliers.pricing: Carrying cost vs speed premium; never exceed 50 SKUs without turnover proof
suppliers.trade_account: Owned — funded from deposits, not debt
suppliers.strength: Same-day issue for Gaborone corporate; programme replenishment
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: You hold the fast-mover advantage competitors squander by holding slow stock
suppliers.status: Phase 1 — stock only top 50 after BDB-005 validates demand
suppliers.contact_hint: Inter-warehouse transfer from Amrod BW daily

suppliers.name: Sondor Industries (Display & signage)
suppliers.scale: Event display, boards, exhibition kits — local fabricator lane
suppliers.gap_to_exploit: Specialist overflow for e02–e05 when local partner capacity full
suppliers.contact_hint: Request e02 gazebo + e03 flag landed / local alternative
